question: In diffraction of white light by a prism, which colour of light from VIBGYOR will be bent most?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Violet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When white light travels through a prism, **violet light** bends the most, while red light bends the least.
 
• This occurs because violet light possesses the shortest wavelength among the seven colors in white light, while red light has the longest.
 
• **The dispersion of light,** which separates white light into its constituent colors, is responsible for this phenomenon.
 
• The refractive index of the medium is highest for violet light and lowest for red light. Refraction occurs as light enters the prism at an angle, with the degree of deviation varying based on wavelength. Consequently, different colors deviate at distinct angles, resulting in their separation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Violet light**, with the shortest wavelength among the seven constituent colors of light, experiences the greatest deviation, while red light, with the longest wavelength, undergoes the least. 
 
• Thus, the order of colors, commonly remembered as **VIBGYOR (violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, red),** reflects this sequence based on their respective wavelengths and degrees of deviation.
